column1: # The Start menu's "Get Apps" folder, created in the prefix template by
# make-prefix.sh, and read by wine-tv-install. Tab-separated columns:
#   folder, shortcut name, winetricks verb (or build/verbs/<verb>.verb),
#   program to start once installed (apps only; 32-bit x86 builds, as this
#   Wine runs 32-bit x86 Windows programs through FEX),
#   optionally a file that shows the entry is installed (default: the program).
